parsed.post: Found a huge jump! Increasing DEPTH to 6 (with my previous LR 0.05/warmup config) dropped val_bpb from 1.0456 to 1.0159. More capacity is helping significantly within the 5-min window. I'm now going to probe the ASPECT_RATIO to see if we can further optimize the structure.
parsed.description: Combining DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=64 to see if wider/taller models benefit from the increased parameter count.
